items: Seed dibber (only if not done barb training)
Runes for any charge orb spell you have the level to cast
rec: Khazard teleports, Ardougne cloak or Spirit tree (3) (2)
Feldip hills teleport or Hunter/Max cape
rewards: 100 x Death runes from Movario's base
100 x Fire runes from Movario's base
100 x Magic logs from Movario's base
Access to Tormented Demons in the Ancient Guthixian Temple

st.t: Talk to Ivy Sophista in Taverley south of the witch's house.
Go up the ladder next to Ivy.
Talk to Thaerisk.

Kill the assassins. Use Protect from Ranged. If one says 'Now!' they will fire a hard-hitting ranged attack if not prayed against. Straight after, the other will say 'Nothing personal, adventurer', they will teleport to you and dragon dagger spec you. Protect from Melee straight after the strong ranged attack hits to be safe.
Talk to Thaerisk again.
Talk to the Khazard Launderer west of the Khazard Fight Arena.
Talk to the Hunting Expert in her hut in the middle of the Feldip Hills hunting area.
s: Do you think you could help me with broavs?
A creature to help track down a person.

st.t: Set up the trap west of the Hunting Expert.
Use the mort myre fungus on the trap west of the Hunting Expert.
Wait for the broav to fall into the trap.
Dismantle the trap to retrieve the broav.
Bring the unconscious broav to the Feldip Hills hunting expert.
s: Do you think you could train this broav for me?
A creature to help track down a person.

st.t: Go to the broken table in the middle of the Khazard side of the Khazard-Gnome battlefield.
Drop your broav.
Use the dirty shirt on your broav.
Search the broken table.

tr: Khazard teleports, Ardougne cloak or Spirit tree (3) (2)
Feldip hills teleport or Hunter/Max cape

st.t: Enter Movario's base under the broken table in the Khazard Battlefield.
Search the open chest in the far north of the area for some runes.
Climb down the stairs to the north-west.
Inspect the old battered door.

On the door's warning, one letter of the word PROHIBITED is styled like a rune, and it differs per player. Use that rune on the door. A wrong rune hits you for 20+ damage, but the blast's colour shows the right one: purple for mind, green for earth, white for air, red for fire and blue for water.
Enter the old battered door. You must weigh more than 0 kg to enter, so take off weight-reducing gear such as graceful if you need to.

Solve the electricity puzzle. Search the bookcases until the chat box says you pulled a lever. Wires on the floor then light up from that bookcase: follow them to the next bookcase and search it. Keep following the lit wires until a message says the electric gate has been turned off.
Enter the gate to the staircase.
Long-press the spiral staircase and choose Search.
Climb up the spiral staircase.
Search the desk north-west of the staircase.
Pick-up the waste-paper basket west of the desk.
Search the waste-paper basket.
Use the ruby key on the most north-west bookcase.
Go up the stairs that appeared.
Search the bed.
Use the ruby key on the bed chest.
Long-press the bed chest and choose Search to check it for traps. Don't choose Open, as the trap hits for 18 or more damage.
Take the second pair of notes from the bed chest.
Read Movario's notes (vol. 1).
Read Movario's notes (vol. 2).
Go back downstairs.
Inspect the painting in the south of the room.

Cross the broken wall into the south room. The pressure gauge shows how much you weighed on entering, in tickits (1 tickit = 1 kg). Check your weight now on the Equipment Stats screen, then take the difference from the pile of 1 kg, 2 kg and 5 kg weights.

Cross back over the broken wall into the north room. If you weighed more than the pressure gauge's number before taking the weights, use all of them on the statue in the north-east of the room. If you weighed less, keep them in your inventory.
Leave through the door in the north-east.
Return to Thaerisk upstairs in Taverley with the notes.
Go to McGrubor's Wood (fairy ring ALS) and enter the building through the loose railing to the east for a cutscene. Kill the mercenaries there. You can also destroy Movario's notes now.
Talk to Idria just north of McGrubor's Wood.
Talk to Akrisae in the White Knights' Castle, on the ground floor on the east side.
Talk to Akrisae again to teleport to Draynor Village.
Use the orb on the shady stranger near Draynor Village bank.
Return to Akrisae in the White Knights' Castle.
Get a snapdragon seed from Thaerisk for free.
Talk to Thaerisk to teleport to Port Sarim.
s: Could you teleport me to Port Sarim?

st.t: Talk to Betty in Port Sarim's magic shop with a snapdragon seed and lantern lens.
s: Could you help me make some enriched snapdragon?

st.t: Talk to Betty in Port Sarim's magic shop for some pink dye.
Use the pink dye on a lantern lens.
Stand in Betty's doorway and use the rose-tinted lens on the counter.
Take the seed from Betty's counter.
Return to Thaerisk with the enriched snapdragon seed.
i: Seed dibber (only if not done barb training)

st.t: Plant the enriched snapdragon seed in the herb patch on the top floor of the west side of the White Knights' Castle.
Return to Idria downstairs near Thaerisk.

i: Seed dibber (only if not done barb training)

st.t: Activate the lunar spellbook for NPC Contact. Either use the altar on Lunar Isle, your POH altar, or your Magic Cape.
Use NPC Contact to talk to Cyrisus.
Use NPC Contact to talk to Turael, or go talk to him in Burthorpe.
s: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

st.t: Use NPC Contact to talk to Mazchna, or go talk to him in Canifis.
s: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

st.t: Use NPC Contact to talk to Duradel, or go talk to him in Shilo Village.
s: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

st.t: Go back onto the normal spellbook, then go harvest the enriched snapdragon in the herb patch on the top floor of the west side of the White Knights' Castle.
Return to Thaerisk with the enriched snapdragon.
Use the enriched snapdragon on the serum.
Search the drawers in the south-east of the room.
Enter the cell just north of Thaerisk.
Use the super truth serum on the shady stranger in the cell near Thaerisk.
Talk to the shady stranger.
Use the sketch on Idria.
Talk to Ghommal outside of the entrance to the Warriors' Guild.
s: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

st.t: Talk to Harrallak Menarous in the entrance to the Warriors' Guild.
s: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

st.t: Talk to Sloane on the first floor of the Warriors' Guild, in the north-east, through the heavy door.
s: I need to talk to you about Lucien.

st.t: Get ready first: use the normal spellbook, keep 9 inventory slots free, and wear a bronze med helm and iron chainbody (or your dark squall robes, if you have them). For the fight with Surok, bring runes for many casts of a Bind spell, a Weaken spell, Low Level Alchemy, Telekinetic Grab and all four elemental spells. Then return to Akrisae in the White Knights' Castle, on the ground floor on the east side.
i: Runes for any charge orb spell you have the level to cast

st.t: Enter the Black Knights' Fortress. Akrisae will give you a one-off teleport there.
i: Runes for any charge orb spell you have the level to cast

st.t: Push the wall to enter a secret room.
Go down the ladder.
Inspect the tile on the floor on the east side of the room.
Cast one of the charge orb spells on the tile.
i: Runes for any charge orb spell you have the level to cast

st.t: Enter the tile trapdoor.
Jump over the west bridge.
Climb up the northern wall in the north-east area.
Continue through the catacomb until you reach some solid doors in the north-west. Enter the west door.
Enter the most northern solid door.

Kill elite black knights until you have the full helm, platebody and platelegs, with Protect from Melee on. If none is here, one stands with the elite dark warriors just past the west bridge you jumped. Then wear all three: the elite knights, warriors, mages and rangers stop attacking you while you wear them.
Search the wardrobe to the north.
Search the key rack just east of the northern wardrobe.
Search the wardrobe to the south.
Search the south table for a strange teleorb.
Search the west desk for a law and death rune.
Search the north-east table for some lobster and a restore potion. DON'T EAT OR DRINK EITHER.
Leave the room back to the catacombs.
Open Silif's cell door in the north-east of the area.
Use a lobster or other food on Silif.
Use a restore potion on Silif.
Use the elite black armour on Silif.
Talk to Silif until he follows you.
Enter the most northern solid door again.
Stand near the map just east of the door until Silif talks about it.
Talk to Silif near the map until he gives you a teleorb.
Wear the dark squall robes, then climb up the ladder to the east, ready to fight Surok.

Defeat Surok. You must use magic to hurt him. You cannot use powered staves. He has three special attacks: 1. A henchman appears. Cast 'Weaken' on a 'Strong' one, or 'Bind' on a 'Agile' one. If they reach you you will take 40+ damage. 2. Surok throws an explosive orb. You must telegrab it, and then alch it, or you will take 45+ damage. 3. Surok casts a surge attack. Cast the opposite elemental spell back. Cast Air for Earth, Water for Fire, Earth for Air, Fire for Water.
Use the teleorb on Surok Magis.
Return to Akrisae in the White Knights' Castle, on the ground floor on the east side.

i: Runes for any charge orb spell you have the level to cast
r: Many casts of a Bind spell
Many casts of a Weaken spell
Many casts of Low level alchemy spell
Many casts of a Telekinetic grab
Many casts of your strongest wind, water, earth, and fire spells

st.t: If you don't have the dark squall robes, talk to Silif near Akrisae for them. Wear the robes, then enter the cell near Akrisae.
Only if you don't already have the strange teleorb, a law rune and a death rune: climb down the ladder to get them. If you have all three, skip this step and the next three.
Search the west desk for a law and death rune.
Search the south table for a strange teleorb.
Climb back up the ladder to the east.
Stand in the middle of the room.
Activate the strange teleorb. Make sure your law and death rune are not in a rune pouch.
Climb the ice wall in the north-east, next to the chaos temple.
Jump across the ledge, and watch the following cutscene.
Return to Idria in Falador Castle.
Teleport to the Tears of Guthix using a games necklace, or travel there through the Lumbridge Swamp.
Talk to Movario in the north-west of the area.
Use a lit sapphire lantern on one of the light creatures to descend into the abyss.
Search the remains to the north-east for a spade.
Search the remains in the middle of the area for a hammer and chisel.
Use a spade on the rocks in the north-east of the area.
Use a chisel on the brazier in the north-east of the area.
Use a spade on the rocks in the north-west of the area.
Use a chisel on the north-west brazier.
Use a chisel on the south-west brazier.
Use a chisel on the south-east brazier.
Look at the three recessed blocks next to the cavities to the far south: their symbols differ per player. Use the air orb on the one with the air symbol.
You can drop the spade, chisel and hammer now. Use the fire orb on the recessed block with the fire symbol, next to one of the three cavities to the far south.
Use the earth orb on the recessed block with the earth symbol, next to one of the three cavities to the far south.
Climb up the walls to the south.
Use the water orb on the recessed block just to the south, in the skeleton's mouth.
Use the fire block on the recessed block just to the south, in the skeleton's mouth.
Climb back down.
Take off anything in your weapon and shield slots, then enter the western cavity.
Crawl to the end and look at the mechanism's symbol. Which element it needs differs per player: use the air, earth or water block with the matching symbol on the recess.
Return back to the main area.
Enter the middle cavity.
Crawl to the end and look at the mechanism's symbol. Which element it needs differs per player: use the air, earth or water block with the matching symbol on the recess.
Return back to the main area.
Enter the eastern cavity.
Crawl to the end and look at the mechanism's symbol. Which element it needs differs per player: use the air, earth or water block with the matching symbol on the recess.
Return back to the main area.
Climb up the walls to the south.
Inspect the stone cube.
Enter the skull's mouth to the south.
Search the skeleton north of the stone table.
Cast bloom near any of the roots for items to fill your druid pouch with.
Use the druid pouch on nearby druid spirits for herblore ingredients.

Eight statues each need the ingredients of one potion, and which potion differs per player: examine a statue to see which potion it needs. Use the right ingredients on the statues up these paths, in this order: south-west path (down the south branch), north-west path, south-east path (up the north branch), west path, south-east path (down the south branch), north-east path, south-west path (up the north branch), east path. You can get ingredients by using your druid pouch on the druid spirits around the area.

Potion ingredients. Agility: toadflax, toad's legs. Energy: harralander, chocolate dust. Restoration: harralander, red spider's eggs. Attack: guam leaf, eye of newt. Strength: tarromin, limpwurt root. Defence: ranarr weed, white berries. Combat: harralander, goat horn dust. Ranged: dwarf weed, wine of Zamorak. Prayer: ranarr weed, snape grass. Hunter: avantoe, kebbit teeth dust. Fishing: avantoe, snape grass. Magic: lantadyme, potato cactus. Balance: harralander, red spider's eggs, garlic, silver dust.
Use all the dolmens on the stone table in the middle of the area.
Head through the now open entrance to the south and approach the Stone of Jas, ready to fight.

Fight the Balance Elemental. You need all 3 combat styles to defeat it. If you pray incorrectly against the first new style of attack, your stats will be majorly drained. As its health gets lower, it starts to attack faster. When it has a fire head, it attacks with ranged. When it has an air head, it attacks with melee. When it has a water head, it attacks with magic.
Touch the Stone of Jas.
Talk to Movario.
Defeat the Tormented Demons. Your stats are 255 each.
Talk to Idria to teleport back to Falador Castle.
Return to Akrisae in the White Knights' Castle, on the ground floor on the east side, to finish the quest!
